item.title: Tap or Swipe: How Mobile Wallets Affect the Payment Method Dichotomy
item.summary: Whether it’s through tapping-to-pay, swiping a card through a reader, or inserting a chip, card-based payment methods have become a staple of making everyday purchases. For years, it seemed as if such payment methods, which have largely replaced cash, could go no further; from a layperson’s point of view, what could be more convenient than […]
